coarse_skill_concept: Modify a C project's Makefile or configure script to inject additional compiler flags that change the build artifact (coverage instrumentation or IR emission) without breaking the existing build.

task_judgments.reason: Setting CFLAGS with -ftest-coverage -fprofile-arcs before ./configure is exactly the flag-injection procedure the candidate skill describes.

The solution replaces the compiler with the wllvm wrapper (CC=wllvm) and then runs extract-bc + llvm-dis post-build; this is a whole-program bitcode extraction workflow, not flag injection into an existing compiler.

final_groups.skill_concept: Set CFLAGS/LDFLAGS environment variables before invoking an autoconf configure script to inject coverage instrumentation flags (e.g. -fprofile-arcs -ftest-coverage) and produce a gcov-instrumented build via make.
final_groups.reasoning: sqlite-with-gcov is solved purely by prepending CFLAGS to ./configure and running make; no non-standard tooling is needed beyond standard gcc coverage flags.

final_groups.skill_concept: Use the wllvm compiler-wrapper toolchain (CC=wllvm, extract-bc, llvm-dis) to build a complex autoconf C project and extract whole-program LLVM IR.
final_groups.reasoning: sudo-llvm-ir requires substituting the compiler with wllvm, running configure and make, then post-processing the linked binary with extract-bc and llvm-dis — a pipeline fundamentally different from mere flag injection.
